title: A parity-contracts golden fixture
description: A whole Kafka record or a gRPC script. Header and key rules beyond structure are checked by contract-check (CONVENTIONS.md). Since 0.4.0 also a tenant maps file (kind tenant_maps), checked against schemas/tenants/tenant-maps.v1.json and the rules of CONVENTIONS.md's "Tenant maps". Since 0.5.0 also a parity-store record (kind store), checked against schemas/store/ and CONVENTIONS.md's "parity-store API". Since 0.10.0 also a parity-billing record (kind billing), checked against schemas/billing/, schemas/admin/ and CONVENTIONS.md's "Billing API", "Entitlements" and "Provisioning". Since 0.13.0 also log lines (kind log), checked against schemas/logging/log-record.v1.json, the catalogues named and CONVENTIONS.md's "Logging (log-record.v1)". Since 0.16.0 also a parity-rs tenant routing record (kind routing_ops), checked against schemas/tenant-routing/ and CONVENTIONS.md's "Tenant routing API".

writer_valid.description: false: the last call breaks the gRPC rules in violates (telephony.v1, and routing.v1 since G5)

given.description: Initial state: parity.telephony.v1's and (G5) parity.routing.v1's are fixed below; a routing.v1 script with given is executable

parity.agents.v1: IE's CallEnded for a reservation (wrap-up starts)
parity.routing.v1 (G5): the agent becomes ready now (agents.v1 SetState)
parity.routing.v1 (G5): the agent answers its latest offer (agents.v1 AnswerOffer); result is what it must get, no_offer when it was never offered this script's calls
0.11.0 (agents.v1 scripts): the stand-in IE reports CONNECTED for the reservation
0.11.0: a supervisor's forced state, which the harness performs through agents.v1 ForceState

0.11.0: what RE must make of the stimulus (a subset of the harness's answer: applied, pending, silent, refused, why)
